Research-survey paper: p.899 states Iduh (O Du) in Vietnam (7 native speakers) was known only from Vương Hoàng Tuyên 1963, Đặng Nghiêm Vạn's brief ethnographic sketches and his unpublished 75-word list; Proschan recorded all 7 speakers in Nghệ An (1994-95) and the Tay Hat dialect in eastern Xieng Khouang with Thongpheth Kingsada (Oct 1995). No phonological description, no mention of stress/accent for Iduh.
